title: Split the series
text: Split it into two geometric series, one with ratio $$\frac{1}{\left(x-3\right)^2}$$ and one with ratio $$\frac{1}{\left(x-2\right)^2}$$.

title: Sum each part
text: The first sums to $$\frac{x-3}{\left(x-3\right)^2-1}$$ and the second sums to $$\frac{x-2}{\left(x-2\right)^2-1}$$. Subtract them.
